invariants.rationale: The method assumes the input collection exists; many collection methods would throw otherwise.
The reduction cannot proceed if the function is null, and this is often a precondition.
Parallelism should be positive for partitioned parallel stream processing.
parallelism often does not exceed the data size, unless data is empty; more threads than elements is wasteful.
Input data collection should not contain nulls for grouping and mapping to work as expected.
